what_to_detect: A turn_action record of subkind phasing at a player's untap step holds phased events: permanents of that player with phasing phase out (out true) and their phased-out permanents with phasing phase in (out false).
near_miss: A phasing turn_action in the other player's untap step that holds no phased event for this player's permanents.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose instruction acts on all permanents of a kind (destroy, sacrifice, damage) in which a permanent that is phased out at that moment is left unaffected: the snapshot marks it phased out and no event names it.
near_miss: The same resolution in which a phased-in permanent of the kind is affected.
record_fields: snapshot entity designations phased out / phase_state

what_to_detect: A resolution that phases out a creature that is attacking or blocking: a phased event (out true) whose subject the snapshot before the resolution shows in combat; the creature is then absent from the combat record's participants. A Phases resolution writes no removed_from_combat event (the collector emits that only for the RemoveFromCombat and ChangeCombatants APIs), and the evidence is in a resolution record while the scenario's kind is combat.
near_miss: A Phases resolution that phases out a permanent not in combat.
record_fields: snapshot combat (attackers, blockers) before the resolution

what_to_detect: A phased event with no zone_change among the events for the same permanent, so no leaves-the-battlefield or enters trigger is evaluated and counters in the snapshot stay. The phased event is in the Phases resolution's effect half, while the scenario's kind is trigger.
near_miss: A zone_change leave-and-return of a permanent (a blink), where enter triggers are evaluated and fired.

what_to_detect: A continuous-effect record created by a resolved spell or ability whose affected set omits a permanent that was phased out when the effect was created, the phased-out permanent absent from contributions.
near_miss: The same effect's contributions including a phased-in permanent of the kind.

what_to_detect: A for-as-long-as effect (control, stat change) ending at the moment the permanent it tracks phases out: a control_change back to the owner in the same record as the phased event.
near_miss: The permanent staying in play and phased in with the control effect still contributing.

what_to_detect: A phasing turn_action in which a permanent phases out together with its attached Aura or Equipment (indirect phasing): phased events naming both, or the attachment phasing back in with its host.
near_miss: A phasing turn_action in which a permanent phases out with no attachment, or the attachment is unattached from it.

what_to_detect: A phasing turn_action in which a directly phased-out Equipment phases in and ends attached to a host that is still on the battlefield (an attached event or kept link).
near_miss: A phasing-in Equipment whose host left the battlefield, so it comes in unattached.

what_to_detect: A phased event for a permanent with an attachment in which no unattached event is written and no unattach trigger is evaluated. The phased event is in the Phases resolution's effect half, while the scenario's kind is trigger.
near_miss: An equip activation that moves the attachment, with an unattached event and an unattach trigger evaluated.

what_to_detect: An untap step in which no phasing happens: the untap-step phasing turn_action holds no phased event (or is absent) though phasing permanents exist, because the untap step was skipped.
near_miss: An untap step with a phasing turn_action holding phased events.

what_to_detect: A permanent with two instances of phasing phasing once in a phasing turn_action: a single phased event for it, not a phase-out and phase-in pair.
near_miss: A permanent with one phasing instance showing the same single phased event.
